blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Immunity) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Answer both parts. (i) Name the parts of the body that form the first line of defence. (ii) Explain how the skin keeps microbes out both physically and chemically. (4 marks)
(Dono hisse hal karein. (i) Pehli line of defence banane wale jism ke hisse batayein. (ii) Wazahat karein ke skin microbes ko jismani aur kimiyai dono tarah kaise rokti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Pehli line of defence skin, digestive tract aur respiratory tract par mushtamil hai.

(ii) Jismani rukawat: skin jism ki sab se bahar wali tah hai. Is ki epidermis 10 se 30 cells moti hai. Bahar wali tah stratum corneum ke cells musalsal kharab ho kar jharte hain. Gehri epidermis mein naye cells ban kar upar aate aur purane cells ki jagah lete hain. Yeh cells keratin protein banate hain jo skin ko sakht aur microbes ke liye na-qabil-e-guzar banata hai.
Kimiyai rukawat: oil aur sweat glands skin ka pH 3-5 kar dete hain; yeh tezabiyat bohat se microbes ko barhne nahi deti. Paseene mein lysozyme enzyme hai jo bohat se bacteria ki cell walls ko tor kar hazam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Skin is the outermost layer of our body. It provides the first defence against invasion of microbes.

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe how microbes entering with food and with inhaled air are stopped before they reach the deep tissues. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke khane aur saans ki hawa ke saath aane wale microbes gehre tissues tak pohanchne se pehle kaise roke jate hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Khane ke saath (digestive tract):
1. Zyada tar bacteria munh mein saliva se marte hain jis mein lysozyme hai.
2. Maeday ke tez digestive acids bacteria marte hain.
3. Aant ke protein hazam karne wale enzymes bhi bacteria marte hain.

Hawa ke saath (respiratory tract):
1. Naak ke ciliated epithelial cells bohat se bacteria ko hawa ki naali se pehle pakar lete hain.
2. Chhoti bronchi aur bronchioles ke cells chipchipa mucus banate hain jo microbes ko garam, nam lungs se pehle pakar leta hai.
3. Cilia mucus ko musalsal upar dhakelte hain jahan woh nigla ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Many microbes are present in the air that we breathe.

blocks.prompt:
3 Answer both parts. (i) When does the second line of defence act, and why is it called non-specific? (ii) Name its four most important devices and the three kinds of germ-killer cells. (4 marks)
(Dono hisse hal karein. (i) Doosri line kab kaam karti hai aur isay non-specific kyun kehte hain? (ii) Is ke chaar sab se aham tareeqe aur germ-killer cells ki teen qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Pehli line bohat moassar hai magar kabhi kabhi hamla awar isay paar kar lete hain. Jab woh gehre tissues tak pohanchte hain to doosri line kaam karti hai. Pehli line ki tarah yeh bhi non-specific hai: yeh kisi khaas germ ko nishana nahi banati balki aam cellular aur kimiyai tareeqe istemal karti hai.

(ii) Chaar aham tareeqe:
1. Khoon ke germ-killer cells
2. Antimicrobial (protective) proteins
3. Inflammatory response
4. Temperature response
Germ-killer cells, jo sab se aham non-specific defence dete hain, teen qisam ke hain: macrophages, neutrophils aur natural killer cells.

book_ref.quote: Human body uses a lot of non-specific cellular and chemical devices in its second line of defence.

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe how natural killer cells destroy infected and cancer cells. Explain why the patrolling cells do not attack the body's own normal cells. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke natural killer cells infected aur cancer cells ko kaise tabah karte hain. Wazahat karein ke gasht karne wale cells jism ke apne normal cells par hamla kyun nahi karte.)
blocks.explanation:
NK cells ka maarna:
1. NK cells khud microbes ko nahi marte; woh virus se infected jism ke cells ko pehchan kar un par hamla karte hain.
2. Yeh perforins naam ke khaas proteins chhorte hain jo target cell ki membrane mein ghus jate hain.
3. Is se membrane mein surakh ban jata hai.
4. Surakh se paani andar aata hai aur cell phool kar phat jata hai.
5. Yeh cancer cells ko bhi pehchan kar tumour banne se pehle maar dete hain.

Self-proteins: jism ke tamam normal cells par self-protein marker hota hai jo unhein pehchan deta hai. Gasht karne wale cells self-protein wale cells par hamla nahi karte; sirf un par karte hain jin mein yeh nahi.

Note (book correction): NK cells innate defence ke lymphocytes hain, T cells nahi, aur cytotoxic T cells bhi nahi.

book_ref.quote: They do not kill invading microbes, rather they detect and attack the body cells

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe how the complement system kills a microbe, and compare its way of making a cell burst with that of natural killer cells. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke complement system microbe ko kaise marta hai, aur cell phaarne ke is tareeqe ka natural killer cells ke tareeqe se muwazna karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Complement system: liver mein bane khaas proteins complement system banate hain; yeh darjan se zyada proteins hain jo khoon mein ghair fa'al halat mein ghoomte hain. Microbe milne par yeh silsilay se fa'al hote hain: pehla doosre ko, phir aage. Aakhri paanch proteins microbe ki membrane mein membrane-attack complex (MAC) banate hain. MAC membrane mein surakh karta hai, fluids aur namak andar jate hain aur microbe phool kar phat jata hai.

Muwazna:

book_ref.quote: When they encounter a microbe, they become active in a sequence.

rows: Khoon mein ghoomne wale protective proteins (liver mein bane)
Khoon mein gasht karne wale germ-killer cells
Khud microbe par asar
Virus wale jism ke cells aur cancer cells par asar
Aakhri paanch proteins MAC banate hain
Perforins target membrane mein ghuste hain
Fluids aur namak andar; microbe phool kar phat jata hai
Surakh se paani andar; cell phool kar phat jata hai

blocks.prompt:
6 Trace the events of the inflammatory response from the injury of cells to the cleaning of the site. What is pus? (4 marks)
(Cells ke zakhmi hone se jagah ki safai tak inflammatory response ke marahil bayan karein. Pus kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Infected ya zakhmi cells histamines aur prostaglandins jaise chemical signals chhorte hain.
2. Yeh khoon ki naaliyan phailate hain, jagah par capillary mein khoon ka bahao barhta hai.
3. Capillaries zyada permeable ho jati hain.
4. Jagah par surkhi, soojan aur garmi hoti hai; isay inflammation kehte hain.
5. Garmi microbes ke liye jagah na-munasib banati, shifa barhati aur WBCs ki harkat tez karti hai.
6. Zyada phagocytes (macrophages aur neutrophils) khoon se inflamed tissue mein ja kar microbes nigalte hain.
7. Monocytes aa kar microbes marne wale chemicals chhorte hain; phir macrophages murda microbes, cells aur malba saaf karte hain.
Yeh response aksar microbes ka phailao rokne ke liye kafi hota hai.

Pus: kuch infections ki pus murda ya marte neutrophils, toote tissue cells aur murda pathogens ka murakkab hai.

book_ref.quote: These chemicals cause local expansion of blood vessels.

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain how fever is produced in the body and how it acts as a defence mechanism against microbes. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke jism mein bukhar kaise paida hota hai aur yeh microbes ke khilaf defence ka tareeqa kaise hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Bukhar ka paida hona:
1. Macrophages microbes par hamla karte waqt pyrogens chhorte hain.
2. Pyrogens khoon ke zariye dimagh ke hypothalamus tak pohanchte hain jo jism ka thermostat hai.
3. Yeh hypothalamus ko jism ka andaruni darja hararat normal 37 °C (98.6 °F) se upar le jane par uksate hain.
4. Normal se zyada yeh darja hararat fever (pyrexia) hai.

Bukhar bataur defence:
1. Bacteria aur viruses ki nasal barhne ki salahiyat rokta hai.
2. Hararat se hassas microbes (jaise Streptococcus pneumoniae, influenza) tez bukhar mein mar jate hain.
3. Neutrophils aur macrophages ki raftar barhata hai.
4. Bukhar mein jism zyada cytokines (interferons) chhorta hai.
Magar 103 °F (39.4 °C) se zyada khatarnak aur 105 °F (40.5 °C) se zyada aksar jaan leva hai.

book_ref.quote: When macrophages attack the invading microbes, they release chemicals called pyrogens.

blocks.prompt:
8 Compare the first, second and third lines of defence of the body. (4 marks)
(Jism ki pehli, doosri aur teesri line of defence ka muwazna karein.)
blocks.explanation: Teeno lines of defence mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: The third line of defence (immune system) can remember previous invaders

rows: Skin, digestive aur respiratory tract
Germ-killer cells, protective proteins, inflammation, bukhar
Immune system (monocytes, T cells, B cells)
Non-specific
Non-specific
Specific: khaas germs ko nishana
Microbes ko dakhil hone se rokti hai
Hamla awar gehre tissues tak pohanchein to kaam
Microbes pehli do lines paar karein to kaam
Yaad nahi rakhti
Yaad nahi rakhti
Purane hamla awar yaad rakh kar tez jawab

blocks.prompt:
9 Classify immunity into its types and give the main characteristic of each type. (4 marks)
(Immunity ki qismon ki darja bandi karein aur har qisam ki asal khoobi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Innate (paidaishi) immunity: non-specific defence (pehli aur doosri line) jo paidaish se mojood hai.
2. Acquired (hasil karda) immunity: specific defence jo barhne ke dauran hasil hota hai. Is ki do qismein:
(a) Active immunity: jism khud microbes ke antigens ke khilaf antibodies banata hai. Yeh ho sakti hai:
- Natural active: antigens se saamne par jism qudrati taur par antibodies banata hai; yeh sab se moassar qisam hai.
- Artificial active: kamzor antigens de kar (vaccination); yeh jism ko asal antigens ke khilaf antibodies banane par uksate hain.
(b) Passive immunity: insan ko makhsoos microbes ke khilaf antibodies di jati hain; yeh kam muddat ki hai.

book_ref.quote: The acquired immunity is further of two types i.e., active and passive.

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the origin and maturation of T cells and B cells, and explain why no invader escapes being recognized by T cells. (4 marks)
(T cells aur B cells ki paidaish aur pukhtagi bayan karein, aur wazahat karein ke koi hamla awar T cells se pehchane baghair kyun nahi bach sakta.)
blocks.explanation:
T cells: doosre WBCs ki tarah T cells bone marrow ke stem cells se bante hain. Yeh thymus mein jate hain jo dil ke bilkul upar aik chhota surmai gland hai. Wahan yeh pakte aur microbes par mojood antigens pehchanne ki salahiyat hasil karte hain.

B cells: B cells bhi bone marrow mein bante hain magar T cells ke bar-aks thymus nahi jate; bone marrow mein hi pakte hain. Phir khoon aur lymph mein ghoomne ke liye chhor diye jate hain. T cells ki tarah yeh bhi khaas antigens pehchante hain.

Koi kyun nahi bachta: karoron mukhtalif T cells bante hain aur har aik aik khaas antigen pehchanta hai, is liye har hamla awar ko kam az kam kuch T cells pehchan lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Like other white blood cells, T cells also develop from the stem cells in the bone marrow.

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain how macrophages and helper T cells link the non-specific response to the specific immune responses. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke macrophages aur helper T cells non-specific response ko specific immune responses se kaise jorte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Microbes ke hamle par macrophages unhein nigal kar fori jawab dete hain. Yeh bohat se microbes khatam nahi kar sakta magar immune system (teesri line) ko waqt deta hai.
2. Microbe nigalne wala macrophage helper T cells ke liye khaas proteins banata hai.
3. Helper T cells apne receptors se yeh proteins pehchan kar fa'al ho jate hain.
4. Fa'al helper T cells do mutawazi responses shuru karte hain: cell-mediated immunity (T cells) aur antibody-mediated (humoral) immunity (B cells).
5. Cell-mediated mein yeh T cell growth factor aur macrophages ko khenchne wala factor chhorte hain; antibody-mediated mein antigen wale B cells se jur kar proteins chhorte hain jo unhein plasma cells mein badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: When a macrophage engulfs a microbe, it also produces special proteins for the helper T cells.

blocks.prompt:
12 Answer both parts. (i) How do cytotoxic T cells destroy infected body cells? (ii) How is the cell-mediated response finally shut down, and how is long-term protection kept? (4 marks)
(Dono hisse hal karein. (i) Cytotoxic T cells infected cells ko kaise tabah karte hain? (ii) Cell-mediated response aakhir kaise band hota hai aur lambi hifazat kaise baqi rehti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Attack: cell-mediated immunity jism ko virus infections aur cancer se bachati hai. Cytotoxic T cells ki satah ke receptors infected cells pehchante hain aur T cells un se jur jate hain. In ka tareeqa NK cells jaisa hai: yeh target cell (infected ya cancer cell) ki membrane mein surakh karte hain aur cell phat jata hai.

(ii) Suppression: suppressor T cells cytotoxic T cells ka response rokte hain. Yeh aahista barhte hain, is liye shuru mein kam tadad hamla nahi rok sakti. 1 se 2 hafton baad in ki tadad itni ho jati hai ke cytotoxic response band ho jata hai.
Memory: suppression ke baad helper aur cytotoxic T cells ki aik abadi shayad umr bhar baqi rehti hai. Yeh memory cells usi microbe se dobara milne par tez jawab dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The receptors present on the surface of cytotoxic T cells recognize the infected body cells

blocks.prompt:
13 Trace the pathway of a B cell from binding an antigen to the formation of plasma cells, antibodies and memory B cells. (4 marks)
(B cell ke antigen se jurne se plasma cells, antibodies aur memory B cells banne tak ka safar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Jurna: har B cell apni satah ke B receptor proteins se antigens se jurta hai.
2. T cells ki madad: helper T cells antigen wale B cells ko pehchan kar un se jurte aur proteins chhorte hain jo B cell ki afzaish karwate hain.
3. Proliferation: har B cell se bohat se plasma cells bante hain.
4. Differentiation aur secretion: zyada tar plasma cells taqseem band kar ke B receptor proteins banate hain jo khaarij ho kar antibodies kehlate hain; chand dinon mein bohat si antibodies ban jati hain. Antibodies antigens ko tabahi ke liye nishan zada karti hain.
5. Suppression: kai hafton baad suppressor T cells antibody response band kar dete hain.
6. Memory: fa'al B cells ke clone ke kuch members plasma cells nahi bante; woh memory B cells ban kar baqi rehte hain aur usi antigen par baad mein tez secondary response dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Each B cell binds to the antigens through the B receptor proteins on its surface.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book kehti hai memory B cells plasma cells ke clone se bante hain. Durust: plasma cells sirf antibodies banane wale aakhri cells hain; memory B cells fa'al B cells ke clone ke un members se bante hain jo plasma cells nahi bante.

blocks.prompt:
14 Antibodies do not destroy an antigen directly. Describe the three mechanisms by which an antibody-coated antigen is destroyed. (4 marks)
(Antibodies antigen ko seedha tabah nahi karti. Woh teen tareeqe bayan karein jin se antibody laga antigen tabah hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Antibodies sirf antigen ko nishan zada karti hain; tabahi teen tareeqon mein se kisi aik se hoti hai:
1. Complement: antigen se juri kuch antibodies complement proteins fa'al karti hain. Yeh antibody lage antigen ki membrane mein ghus kar surakh karte hain. Paani andar khinchta hai aur cell phool kar phat jata hai.
2. Macrophages: antigen se juri kuch antibodies ko macrophage pehchan leta hai aur antigen ko nigal kar tor deta hai.
3. Killer cells: yeh NK cells jaise hain magar in par antibody lage antigens pehchanne wale receptors hain. Antibody laga antigen milne par yeh us se jur kar cell ko maar dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Rather, they mark it for destruction by one of three mechanisms.

blocks.prompt:
15 Answer both parts. (i) What is a vaccine? (ii) Describe how the immune system is being combined with gene therapy against malignant melanoma. (4 marks)
(Dono hisse hal karein. (i) Vaccine kya hai? (ii) Bayan karein ke malignant melanoma ke khilaf immune system ko gene therapy ke saath kaise milaya ja raha hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Vaccine mare hue ya kamzor pathogens se banti hai jo antibodies banwate hain. Yeh antibodies aur memory cells ki tashkeel ko uksati hai.

(ii) Malignant melanoma jaan leva skin cancer hai. Aik khaas WBC, tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL), tumour par hamla karta hai magar usay qaboo karne ke liye kafi taqatwar nahi. Genetic engineers TIL mein aisa gene daalne ki koshish kar rahe hain jo usay tumour necrosis factor (TNF) banane ke qabil kare; TNF tumour cells ko marta hai. Engineered TIL mareez ke khoon mein wapas ja kar tumour mein dakhil honge aur TNF se usay marenge.

book_ref.quote: A special type of WBC called tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) normally attacks a cancerous tumour.

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the structure of an antibody molecule and explain how its structure makes it specific. (4 marks)
(Antibody molecule ki banawat bayan karein aur wazahat karein ke is ki banawat isay makhsoos (specific) kaise banati hai.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Antibody Y shakal ka protein hai.
2. Yeh chaar polypeptide chains se bana hai: do aik jaisi lambi (heavy) aur do chhoti (light) chains.
3. Chaaron chains disulfide bridges se jori hain.
4. Har chain ka constant region (aik class ki sab antibodies mein milta julta) aur variable region (har antibody mein mukhtalif) hota hai.
5. Y ke har baazu mein aik heavy aur aik light chain ke variable regions makhsoos binding site banate hain (har baazu mein aik).

Makhsoosiyat: mukhtalif antibodies ke variable regions mukhtalif hain, is liye binding sites bhi mukhtalif. Isi liye har antibody sirf usi antigen ko tabah karti hai jis ne usay banwaya. Antigen ka sirf chhota hissa, determinant, binding site mein fit hota hai.

book_ref.quote: An antibody is a Y-shaped protein.

blocks.prompt:
17 Define polyclonal and monoclonal antibodies. Describe how hybridoma cells produce monoclonal antibodies and give their uses. (4 marks)
(Polyclonal aur monoclonal antibodies ki tareef karein. Bayan karein ke hybridoma cells monoclonal antibodies kaise banate hain aur in ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Polyclonal antibodies: jab bohat si mukhtalif antibodies aik antigen se jurein, har aik antigen ke alag hisse (determinant) mein fit ho.
Monoclonal antibodies: woh antibodies jo sirf aik determinant se jur sakti hain.

Hybridomas: Cesar Milstein aur George Kohler (Nobel Prize, 1984) ne antibody banane wale plasma cells ko myeloma cancer cells se milaya. Culture mein naye cells, hybridomas, barhne aur taqseem hone lage. Yeh plasma cell ke genes se antibodies aur myeloma ke genes se barhte aur taqseem hote the; yun yeh tezi se barhne wale cells monoclonal antibodies banate rahe.

Istemal:
1. Pecheeda murakkab se makhsoos molecules khalis karna; interferon isi tarah khalis hua.
2. Ilaj mein makhsoos therapies pohanchane ka zariya.
3. Sirf cancer cells par paye jane wale antigens par research jaari hai jin ke khilaf radioactive monoclonal antibodies se cancer cells ko chun kar mara ja sakega.

book_ref.quote: Monoclonal antibodies have proved very important

blocks.prompt:
18 Answer both parts. (i) What are allergens? Give examples. (ii) Describe the two treatments of allergies given in the chapter and explain how desensitization works. (4 marks)
(Dono hisse hal karein. (i) Allergens kya hain? Misalein dein. (ii) Chapter mein di gayi allergy ke do ilaj bayan karein aur wazahat karein ke desensitization kaise kaam karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Allergens woh cheezein hain jo allergy paida karti hain, yani kamzor antigens jin ke liye kuch logon ka immune system hadd se zyada hassas hai. Misalein: dhool, phaphoond, pollen, billi ki khushki, kuch khane aur penicillin jaisi dawaiyan.

(ii) 1. Antihistamine dawaiyan: allergen ke baad E-antibodies mast cells se jurti hain jo histamines chhor kar inflammatory response shuru karte hain. Antihistamine dawaiyan histamines rok kar waqti araam deti hain.
2. Desensitization: antigens ke extracts mareez mein inject kiye jate hain. Is se khoon mein G-antibodies banti hain. Allergen aane par G-antibodies usay E-antibodies tak pohanchne se pehle hi maar deti hain.

book_ref.quote: Many allergies are also treated by injecting the extracts of the antigens in patients.

blocks.prompt:
19 Describe four autoimmune diseases, naming the tissue that the patient's own antibodies attack in each. (4 marks)
(Chaar autoimmune bimariyan bayan karein aur har aik mein batayein ke mareez ki apni antibodies kis tissue par hamla karti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Autoimmune bimariyan tab hoti hain jab immune system jism ke cells aur bairooni cheezon mein farq nahi kar pata aur apne hi cells aur tissues par hamla karta hai.
1. Myasthenia gravis: pathon ki kamzori jis mein mareez apne skeletal muscle cells ke acetylcholine receptors ke khilaf antibodies banate hain. Antibodies receptors se jur jati hain, pathe acetylcholine par rad-e-amal nahi karte aur nerve impulse pathe tak nahi pohanchta.
2. Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE): mareez apne connective tissues aur bare organs ke khilaf antibodies banata hai.
3. Rheumatoid arthritis: mareez jorron ki cartilage ke khilaf antibodies bana kar unhein nuqsan deta hai.
4. Type I (juvenile) diabetes: antibodies pancreas ke insulin banane wale cells tabah karti hain.
Autoimmune bimariyon ki zyada tar dawaiyan aam taur par poori immunity ko daba deti hain.

book_ref.quote: In this case, the immune system attacks and destroys cells and tissues of the body.

blocks.prompt:
20 Explain the role of self-proteins in choosing an organ donor, and describe the methods used to minimize and prevent transplant rejection. (4 marks)
(Organ donor chunne mein self-proteins ka kirdar wazeh karein, aur transplant rejection kam karne aur rokne ke tareeqe bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Self-proteins: har shakhs ke cells par self-proteins hote hain; in ka set molecular 'fingerprints' jaisa hai jo apne T aur B cells pehchante hain aur aam taur par sirf bairooni cells par hamla karte hain. Agar donor organ ke self-proteins na milein to recipient ke T cells us par hamla aur B cells us ke proteins ke khilaf antibodies banate hain (rejection).
Donor chunna: doctor aisa donor dhoondte hain jis ke self-proteins recipient se zyada se zyada milein. Identical twins mein 100% milte hain aur behtareen match khandan mein hota hai; tarteeb: identical twin > sibling > parent > unrelated donor. Ghair rishtedar ke match ka imkan 100,000-200,000 mein 1 hai.

Rejection kam karna aur rokna:
1. Dawaiyan jo recipient ke immune system ko transplant ke khilaf dabati hain (magar infections se larne ki salahiyat bhi kam karti hain).
2. Monoclonal antibodies se transplant par hamla karne wale T cells ko tabah karna.
3. Stem cells se naya immune system banana jo transplant ko apna (self) samjhe.

book_ref.quote: To minimize rejection, doctors look for a donor whose self-proteins are matching
